notes: Jurisdiction coverage is complete: 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, and American Samoa.

Organization directory is an expanded discovery seed, not a legally verified complete census. Records marked directory_seed_source_review_required must be reviewed against current official constitutions, membership rosters, and governing documents before operational activation.

Several states support multiple independent, private-school, public-school-system, or regional competition bodies. The starter set includes examples for Iowa, Texas, North Carolina, New York, California, and DC; this is not exhaustive.
Association acronyms are aliases, never primary keys; duplicate aliases across jurisdictions are permitted.
U.S. Virgin Islands governance status remains explicitly unverified; island competition organizations must not be treated as confirmed statutory territory-wide authorities.
American Samoa ASHSSA is retained as historical predecessor to the current ASDOE Athletic Office.
Do not infer that every listed body has authority over every school or sport in its jurisdiction. Scope and membership entitlements require separate validation.
